description: This file defines the AttributeBag class, which is a PHP data transfer object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for managing a collection of key-value parameters, including common collection operations like add, replace, get, set, check existence, remove, and iteration.

classes.name: AttributeBag
classes.description: A data transfer object to store and manage a collection of parameters as key-value pairs, supporting typical collection operations and iteration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttributeBag with an optional array of parameters.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all stored parameters as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys of the stored parameters.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces current parameters with a new array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or replaces parameters with the provided array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or default if key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its value from the parameters.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the parameters.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters stored.
